name: MWHEADS1-the-data-pools-again
old: if (own && (!has || [...own.heads, ...own.hairs].every((r) => has(`meshes/${r.model}`)))) return { heads: own.heads, hairs: own.hairs };
note: facePools forgets the port's own: a Breton man walks and is curated over Morrowind's own Breton heads again, the three heads never worn.

name: MWHEADS1-women-wear-them
note: A Breton woman wears a man's head and hair - the batch is the men's.

name: MWHEADS1-the-pools-out-of-order
note: The heads out of id order: the walk lands each seed on another face than facePools' law gives every other race's.

name: MWHEADS1-a-hair-is-a-head
old: id, model: `${id}.nif`, race, part: PART[slot], female,
note: Every record names MW_BODY_PARTS' head, the hairs too.

name: MWHEADS1-the-scene-placement-kept
note: The owner's scene height kept: every part 125 over the Head node, floating over the body.

name: MWHEADS1-the-face-read-as-the-hair
note: The h04 face read off the widow object's hair material: the export names that material the hair's picture, and the bake refuses it.

name: MWHEADS1-every-polygon-baked
old: if (wears && wears(pi) !== material) continue;   // MW-HEADS1: another picture's polygon
new: if (wears && wears(pi) === -1) continue;   // MW-HEADS1: another picture's polygon
note: A material's bake takes the object's other picture's polygons too: a head wearing its hair's geometry in the face's painting.

name: MWHEADS1-the-eyepatch-on-another-portrait
note: Daggerfall's eyepatched Breton, portrait 6, wears a face with two eyes.

name: MWHEADS1-the-viewer-sheets-the-data
note: The face sheet the table is authored against draws Morrowind's Breton men's heads, which no Breton man wears.

name: MWHEADS1-two-eyepatches
note: The eyepatch painted onto h04, whose layout reads both sides of the face from one half of the painting: a face with two eyepatches.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-own-pools-without-their-meshes
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L2-F5: the port's own pools stand whatever the archives carry - a page whose own archive did not load draws a Breton man with no head and no hair.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-one-mesh-is-enough
note: One own mesh present stands the whole pool: a face walks onto a part no archive carries.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-rows-ignore-the-archives
old: const pools = facePools(parts, race, female, { has, own: ownHeads });
new: const pools = facePools(parts, race, female, { own: ownHeads });
note: The rows choose among the own pools whatever the archives carry, while the match was told otherwise.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-third-body-ignores-the-archives
old: { beast, faceIndex, faceMatch, vampire, walk, has: exists, ownHeads });
new: { beast, faceIndex, faceMatch, vampire, walk, ownHeads });
note: The third-person body walks the own pools with no archive under them: no head and no hair.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-match-pools-ignore-the-archives
old: const pools = werewolf || npcFace ? null : facePools(parts, race, female, { has: archiveHas(archives), own: ownHeads });
new: const pools = werewolf || npcFace ? null : facePools(parts, race, female, { own: ownHeads });
note: The match, its skip and its key read the own pools where the rows read the data's.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-the-match-measured-anyway
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L2-F6: every Breton man's build reads his portrait and measures all six own parts for a verdict the curated table overrides.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-one-curated-half-is-enough
note: A table naming the head alone stands the match down, and the hair falls to the walk.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-counts-the-data
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L2-F7: the head and hair rows count something other than the pool they chose among.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-key-without-the-pools
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L2-F6: a verdict kept over one pool is read back over another - the data's heads' verdict over the port's own.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-hairs-named-heads
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F4: every hair record a head's - slot and part both, so a pin relating the two passed it.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-box-minimum-only
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F6: a re-export whose crown moved is baked as read.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-paths-heads-only
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F10: the coverage walk forgets the hairs - and the ships pin, which walked the helper's own list, passed it.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-a-material-reads-its-first-texture
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F9: a material whose first texture is not its diffuse one bakes that one's picture.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-any-mapping-read-as-one
old: throw new Error(`LayerElementMaterial: MappingInformationType ${map} is not ByPolygon or AllSame`);
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F9: a material layer mapped some other way read as one material for every polygon.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-no-layer-read-as-material-0
old: if (!layer) throw new Error('the Geometry carries no LayerElementMaterial - there is no material to bake alone');
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L3-F9: a Geometry with no material layer baked as material 0's.

name: MWHEADS1-AUDIT-a-short-material-list-read
note: AUDIT MW-HEADS1 L1-F9: a material list shorter than the polygons read as it stands - the polygons past it dropped from every bake.
